requirement.description: Missing parameter value handling in _map_function_annotations function. Tests fail with "Required parameter 'my-parameter' was not provided with a value" because the function parameters are not properly matched to template inputs when parameter names don't exactly match (e.g., kebab-case vs snake_case).
requirement.contract: Function parameters should be matched to template inputs using flexible name matching including kebab-case to snake_case conversion, and missing required parameters should raise RuntimeError with correct parameter name.

requirement.description: Incorrect handling of output directory paths in _run function leads to IsADirectoryError when attempting to write output files to directory paths instead of files.
requirement.contract: When the output path resolves to a directory, the system should create an output file inside that directory instead of trying to write directly to the directory.

requirement.description: Template inputs mapping logic doesn't properly normalize parameter names from kebab-case to snake_case for Python compatibility, causing mismatches between expected and provided parameter names.
requirement.contract: Template input keys should be properly normalized from kebab-case to snake_case to match Python function parameter names, and vice versa for mapping back.
